How it works

1

Pick from the menu

Espresso, fresh drip, cappuccino and over 30 more drinks, with plant-based milk at no extra charge.

2

Pay in the app

Pix or card. Your order joins the barista's queue as soon as the payment is confirmed.

3

Skip the queue

We let you know when it is ready. Just stop by the counter, say your name and go.

Barista tip

Drip coffee tastes best with water between 90 °C and 96 °C (194 to 205 °F): switch the kettle off as soon as it boils and wait a minute before pouring. Boiling water scorches the grounds and turns the drink bitter. Use two tablespoons of grounds for every cup.

FAQ

Can I schedule my pickup?

Yes. Choose the time when you place the order and it will be ready right when you said.

Is there a lactose-free option?

Yes: lactose-free, oat or almond milk, at no extra charge.

Do you deliver?

We deliver within 3 km of the counter, from 7 am to 7 pm, with your coffee in a thermal pack.
